title: Cryogenic & LNG Components
description: Valve bodies, stems, seal rings, piping, bellows — often with extended stems for cold box penetration
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 1 (CP-Ti) has excellent cryogenic toughness (KV >60J at -196C) and low thermal conductivity, making it ideal for LNG and liquid hydrogen service.
Form: Bar stock for valve stems and small components. Plate for flanges and valve bodies. Tube for piping.
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC turning of valve stems
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 1, annealed, Charpy V-notch tested at -196C (min 27J), helium leak tested
